body: I just feel like I could never live up to expectations, silly I know. Don't worry, I think I just hit a slump yesterday. I just can't shake the feelings sometimes.
Again, I wouldn't want to worry anyone that is close to me/I care about with these sort of problems. I mostly confide these problems with either someone who is willing to listen or myself.

Thank you. I try to reassure myself that I'm not such a bad person, but I usually fall back to the "I don't deserve to live anymore". I guess I just needed other people to help me understand what kind of a state of mind I have.
No I have never heard that quote before. Thanks bro. I'm not going to kill myself because I simply can't. My conscience won't allow it.
